#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
DNS Debug Agent - Logs hostname lookups and encodes results into DNS queries
Sends encoded data to a debug domain (debug-agent.net)
"""

import socket
import struct
import time
import sys
import argparse
from datetime import datetime


class DNSDebugAgent:
    def __init__(self, debug_domain="debug-agent.net"):
        self.debug_domain = debug_domain
        self.log_file = "/var/log/hostname_lookups.log"
        
    def log_lookup(self, hostname, ip_address):
        """Log hostname lookup to file"""
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        log_entry = f"{timestamp} - Hostname: {hostname}, IP: {ip_address}\n"
        
        try:
            with open(self.log_file, "a") as f:
                f.write(log_entry)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error writing to log file: {e}")
    
    def encode_to_dns_query(self, data):
        """Encode data into a DNS query format"""
        # Simple encoding: convert data to hex and split into labels
        hex_data = data.encode('utf-8').hex()
        # Split into chunks of 10 characters (5 bytes) to fit DNS label limits
        chunks = [hex_data[i:i+10] for i in range(0, len(hex_data), 10)]
        # Join with dots and append debug domain
        encoded_query = ".".join(chunks) + "." + self.debug_domain
        return encoded_query[:253]  # DNS name limit is 253 characters
    
    def send_dns_query(self, query):
        """Send a DNS query to encode our debug data"""
        try:
            # This will intentionally fail since debug-agent.net is not a real DNS server
            # But the query will be visible in network captures
            socket.gethostbyname(query)
        except socket.gaierror:
            # Expected error - we're just using this to generate DNS traffic
            pass
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Unexpected error during DNS query: {e}")
    
    def resolve_hostname(self, hostname):
        """Resolve hostname and log/send results"""
        try:
            ip_address = socket.gethostbyname(hostname)
            self.log_lookup(hostname, ip_address)
            
            # Encode the result into a DNS query
            debug_data = f"{hostname}|{ip_address}|{int(time.time())}"
            dns_query = self.encode_to_dns_query(debug_data)
            self.send_dns_query(dns_query)
            
            return ip_address
        except socket.gaierror as e:
            error_msg = f"Failed to resolve {hostname}: {e}"
            print(error_msg)
            self.log_lookup(hostname, "RESOLUTION_FAILED")
            
            # Send error info via DNS too
            debug_data = f"{hostname}|ERROR|{int(time.time())}"
            dns_query = self.encode_to_dns_query(debug_data)
            self.send_dns_query(dns_query)
            
            return None
        except Exception as e:
            error_msg = f"Unexpected error resolving {hostname}: {e}"
            print(error_msg)
            return None
    
    def monitor_hostnames(self, hostnames):
        """Monitor a list of hostnames"""
        for hostname in hostnames:
            print(f"Resolving {hostname}...")
            ip = self.resolve_hostname(hostname)
            if ip:
                print(f"  -> {ip}")
            else:
                print(f"  -> Resolution failed")
            time.sleep(1)  # Small delay between requests


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="DNS Debug Agent")
    parser.add_argument("hostnames", nargs="*", help="Hostnames to resolve and log")
    parser.add_argument("--domain", default="debug-agent.net", 
                        help="Debug domain to send encoded DNS queries (default: debug-agent.net)")
    parser.add_argument("--monitor", action="store_true",
                        help="Continuously monitor hostnames")
    parser.add_argument("--interval", type=int, default=60,
                        help="Interval in seconds between monitoring rounds (default: 60)")
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    agent = DNSDebugAgent(debug_domain=args.domain)
    
    if not args.hostnames:
        # Default test hostnames if none provided
        args.hostnames = ["google.com", "github.com", "stackoverflow.com"]
    
    if args.monitor:
        print(f"Monitoring mode: Checking hostnames every {args.interval} seconds")
        print(f"Sending debug data to: {args.domain}")
        try:
            while True:
                agent.monitor_hostnames(args.hostnames)
                print(f"Waiting {args.interval} seconds until next check...")
                time.sleep(args.interval)
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\nMonitoring stopped by user")
    else:
        print(f"One-time resolution of hostnames")
        print(f"Sending debug data to: {args.domain}")
        agent.monitor_hostnames(args.hostnames)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
